description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'SavedNewsScreen' that displays a list of news articles saved by the user. It interacts with app state to retrieve saved articles, allows opening individual articles, and supports deleting articles with confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays saved news articles, allowing users to view or delete them.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI consisting of an AppBar and a list of saved news articles, or a message if none are saved.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen, passing the selected article as an argument.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog for deleting a news article, and deletes the article if confirmed.
